prior_prompt:
Create a high-fidelity product UI design comp, landscape desktop 1536x1024, of PAIGE Solo Marketing > Social. This is concept A: VISUAL PUBLISHING DESK. Use the attached existing PAIGE Social screenshot strictly as the source for the established shell, warm Mineral palette, precise gold Command Mark geometry, compact Schibsted Grotesk-like working typography, fine dividers, ordinary familiar controls and navigation character. Replace its text-heavy unavailable KPI cards with the concrete publishing workflow below. Preserve PAIGE brand, left navigation and Marketing tabs. Do not carry over the screenshot's business name, private data, content, giant disclaimers, unavailable-card grid or dated status claims. Set workspace label to YOUR WORKSPACE and use neutral @yourbusiness identities. This is an illustrative design; include a small separate review-frame strip outside product chrome reading 'Concept A — sample content and metrics'.

Composition and task: left native navigation rail about 184px, compact app header 58px with PAIGE direct-command field; native Marketing tabs Overview, Campaigns, Audience, Content, Calendar, Social selected, Email, Analytics in a horizontal row. The real work starts immediately below: heading 'Social', a small magenta NEXUS Megaphone identity and 'Create post' primary ink button. No landing-page hero, no eyebrow label, no empty KPI wall. Compact status/filter toolbar. Below, an image-led working desk occupies the left 56% of available content and a selected post opens in a wide attached side workspace on the right 44%, with its own title and expand, minimize and close controls. The work remains visually related across both regions.

Desk: a tidy but not sterile two-column media grid, one larger selected image creative and compact neighboring posts showing a real authored navy/gold motivational graphic, a cinematic workspace video still with a play control/duration, a three-slide carousel with visible slide stack/count and navigation, and an actual text-post preview. Each post has exact platform icon, circular account avatar or neutral initials, @yourbusiness, format, honest status words ('Draft', 'Ready for review', 'Published', 'Needs check'), and time. Show useful contextual actions. The Published card has small clearly illustrative '174 views · 12 likes' with a last-checked time; another post has 'Metrics not reported yet', never fake zeros. No charts, generic icon tiles or fake progress. Use small real social platform marks for Threads/Instagram/LinkedIn. PAIGE stays Champagne/Command Mark; NEXUS uses original magenta/Megaphone only, no invented face or robot.

Wide post workspace: readable heading 'Make room for better work', a small 'Version 3 · Draft saved' line and toolbar 'Expand', 'Minimize', close. Show exact destination row with neutral avatar and 'Threads · @yourbusiness', large authored media preview of an indigo/gold creative with simple original typography 'ONE LESS THING ON YOUR LIST', editable caption below 'Good systems make room for the work that matters.', and a quiet native tab bar 'Post / Versions / Result'. Near bottom show 'Review exact post' as the primary action and 'Save draft' secondary. The attachment and caption are both visibly part of the preview. Do not imply anything has been sent from this draft. Include a compact link to the same original published result on another selected card, not a new receipt store.

Finish: strong media hierarchy, generously readable imagery, compact utility chrome, Mineral ground #fbf9f5, workspace #f7f4ee, paper #fffdf8, ink #201e23, secondary #67616b, subtle theme dividers, 12-14px card radius, 8px controls; restrained gold for authority/selection and magenta only for NEXUS. Keep familiar fully legible labels, proper spacing, accessible contrast. The subject is the actual visual social work, never an abstract dashboard illustration. No invented commercial claims, testimonials, real tenant names/IDs, provider name exposed as product UI, stock human avatar or decorative gradient. This is one complete realistic app viewport, no device mockup, no perspective, no collage.
